issues.description: The 14 external reads D0001–D0014 remain unsupplied or unverified. Specific gaps: quarterly SIC (common FUNDQ lacks it), annual incorp/state (common FUNDA lacks them; COMPANY historical mapping is unknown), CRSP VWRETD (MSF lacks it; MSI join is unverified), CIK interval semantics, and author state lookups. History includes quarterly lags, prior 3–60 month ROA, current/prior quarter returns, annual prior-year/CRSP windows, current/prior segments and IO, RDQ analyst windows, and dated header links. Code filters selected construction to 1990–2012 and final sample to 1995–2010. The local IBES.DET_GUIDANCE candidate is a meaningful lead for CIG, but does not establish the author CUSIPG/FPE/CIGCODEQ/estimate contract. The prepared CIG table must also supply GVKEY: the forecast-summary projection omits it and the later Compustat-date join uses a.gvkey; no crosswalk is supplied.
Active %INC requires the exact external winsor.SAS file and %WINSOR creates m3 from m2 by fyearq at PCTL=1 99. Macro source/behavior is not packaged; no substitute is supported.

Stata pscore code is inside a SAS block comment and must run separately after merged_sample.dta export; it uses ffind/psmatch2 to save warn_pscore.dta, which active SAS PROC IMPORT consumes as p1. Shared working directory, DTA import/export and p1 columns remain to verify.

Libraries, header CSV, macro include and three DTA handoff/output paths use placeholders or Windows locations. Configure input/, output/ and support/ under a shared run root and update all producer/consumer references coherently.

evidence.quote:
Ying Huang and Xiaolu Zhou retrieved Compustat, CRSP, Thomson Reuters, IBES, and
AuditAnalytics from WRDS, and the 10-K header information from Professor Bill McDonald’s
website (https://sraf.nd.edu/data/augmented-10-x-header-data/). Ningzhong Li obtained First Call
data from WRDS. Xiaolu Zhou followed the steps below to merge the above data to create the
final dataset for the analyses of the manuscript.

Step 1: In SAS, Xiaolu Zhou downloaded the Compustat annual and quarterly financial data and
segment datafile.

Step 2: Xiaolu Zhou used the Compustat GVKEY and WRDS’ CCMXPF linking table
downloaded on 07/27/2018 to merge data from Step 1 with CRSP daily stock return data
downloaded on 12/01/2018 and CRSP monthly stock return data downloaded on 07/29/2018.

Step 3: Xiaolu Zhou used the GVKEY-CIK linking file from WRDS SEC Analytics Suite
downloaded on 07/27/2018 to merge the Audit Analytics lawsuit data downloaded on 11/19/2018
to the data in Step 2.



                                                1

Step 4: Xiaolu Zhou downloaded the 10-K header data from Professor Bill McDonald’s website
on 04/17/2018 and used the GVKEY-CIK linking file in Step3 to merge the lawsuit data to the
data in Step 3.

Step 5: Xiaolu Zhou used the IBES-CRSP linking file created using the WRDS sample code on
03/17/2016 to merge data in Step 4 to IBES data downloaded on 07/27/2018.

Step 6: Xiaolu Zhou used the CUSIP identifier to merge data in Step 5 with the institutional
ownership data generated from Thomas Reuters institutional holding data and the WRDS sample
code downloaded on 08/01/2018.

Step 7: Xiaolu Zhou used the CUSIP identifier to merge data in Step 6 with the beta data generated
using CRSP monthly data and the WRDS sample code downloaded on 07/27/2018.

Step 8: Xiaolu Zhou used the GVKEY identifier to link the First Call, Compustat, and IBES data
merged by Ying Huang on 06/28/2016 with the data in Step 7.

Step 9: Xiaolu Zhou exported the SAS data set to Stata and conducted the main statistical analyses
in Stata.
